title: Correct wavelength formula
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the wavelength λ = (a d) / (2 L), derived from the fringe spacing Δx = a/2 and the double-slit formula Δx = (L λ)/d.

title: Correct minimum thickness formula
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the minimum coating thickness d' = (a d) / (4 n L), derived from d' = λ' / 2 with λ' = λ / n.

title: Identifies fringe spacing
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly interpret the interference pattern to determine the fringe spacing Δx from the given distance 'a' (e.g., Δx = a/2).

title: Applies thin-film condition
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply the condition for constructive interference (or minimum reflection) in a thin film, typically requiring an optical path difference of λ'/2 for a coating on a lens.

title: Accounts for refractive index
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly relate the wavelength in the coating material (λ') to the vacuum/air wavelength (λ) using λ' = λ / n.

title: Clear logical progression
description: Optional Criteria: The solution shows a clear, step-by-step derivation connecting the double-slit measurement to the final coating thickness.

title: Misinterprets fringe spacing
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student misidentifies the fringe spacing (e.g., uses Δx = a instead of a/2).

title: Wrong thin-film condition
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses the condition for destructive interference (e.g., 2nd' = λ'/2) or confuses the phase change condition for the coating.
